summary: Aircastle Limited filed an 8-K on May 20, 2026, disclosing that its subsidiary Aircastle Advisor LLC entered into a $375 million unsecured term loan credit agreement with a group of banks. The loan has a five-year term and bears interest at Term SOFR plus 1.30%. The obligations are guaranteed by Aircastle Limited and its subsidiary. This is a routine financing arrangement, not a special situation, as it involves ordinary debt incurrence with standard covenants and no change of control, restructuring, or strategic event.
